map.放射性衰变计算器依指数律 N=N₀e^(−λt) 求随时间衰减的原子核数目，输入: The radioactive decay calculator uses the exponential law N = N0*e^(-lambda*t) to find the number of nuclei remaining over time, taking the initial amount and time and returning the remainder, which suits nuclear physics and radiation metrology.
map.N = N₀e^(−λt)。 一半衰期后剩约 50%。: N = N0*e^(-lambda*t). After one half-life about 50% remains.
map.随时间衰减的原子核数目。: The number of nuclei decaying over time.
map.填写「初始核数 N₀」。: Enter the "initial number of nuclei N0".
map.现存核数 N = N₀e^(−λt) 随时间的指数衰减。: The remaining nuclei N = N0*e^(-lambda*t) decays exponentially over time.
map.对比不同 λ、t 的剩余核数。: Compare the remaining nuclei for different lambda and t.
map.：N = 1000 × e^(−1) ≈ 367.9 个；约一个平均寿命后剩 3: N = 1000 * e^(-1) = about 367.9; about 36.8% remains after one mean lifetime.
map.：若 t=ln2/λ=693，则 N=500，恰好减半。: If t = ln2/lambda = 693, then N = 500, exactly half.
map.由中子通量、截面与靶核数求反应率: Reaction rate from neutron flux, cross-section and target number
map.由半衰期与摩尔质量求比活度: Specific activity from half-life and molar mass
map.由衰变常数与时间求存活概率: Survival probability from the decay constant and time
map.N 与活度 A 关系？: What's the Relation Between N and Activity A?
map.A=λN，核数越少活度越低，二者同指数衰减。: A = lambda*N, so fewer nuclei means lower activity; both decay with the same exponential law.
map.每个核衰变概率恒定且独立，单位时间衰变数正比于现存数，解即指数。: Each nucleus has a constant, independent decay probability, and the number of decays per unit time is proportional to the number present, so the solution is the exponential law.
